.claude/agents/architect-agent.md.header:
---
name: architect-agent
description: Design the system's technical structure and boundaries in the spec and per-change architecture summary, rather than implementing code or deciding release readiness.
model: opus
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane specs"
---

.claude/agents/coder-agent.md.header:
---
name: coder-agent
description: Implement changes according to the spec and the test plan.
model: sonnet
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [build]
---

.claude/agents/context-quality-reviewer..header:
---
name: context-quality-reviewer
description: Review governed instruction text for coherence and safety as LLM context, rather than deciding whether its methodology is correct engineering judgment.
model: opus
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [intake]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane reviews"
---

.claude/agents/release-manager-agent.md.header:
---
name: release-manager-agent
description: From the assembled release evidence, produce a ship/no-ship release recommendation. The recommendation is what you produce; the release decision is the human's.
model: sonnet
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [release, gate, review-artifact]
---

.claude/agents/reviewer-agent.md.header:
---
name: reviewer-agent
description: Do not review spec documents; they are the Spec Reviewer's. Your review covers implementation quality and consistency. In force until an adopted, published code-review standard replaces it; the intake commit that lands that standard retires this row.
model: opus
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [release, review-artifact]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane reviews"
---

.claude/agents/skeptic-risk-agent.md.header:
---
name: skeptic-risk-agent
description: Review the evidence chain for false confidence and material risk, rather than implementing fixes or making the release recommendation.
model: opus
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [release, review-artifact]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane reviews"
---

.claude/agents/spec-reviewer-agent.md.header:
---
name: spec-reviewer-agent
description: Review the spec for completeness, consistency, traceability, and continuity, rather than reviewing implementation quality or judging governed text as LLM context.
model: opus
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane reviews"
---

.claude/agents/test-designer-agent.md.header:
---
name: test-designer-agent
description: Define how correctness will be evaluated, and what evidence it requires, before implementation begins.
model: sonnet
tools: [Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash]
skills: [build]
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Edit|Write"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/lane-guard --lane tests"
---

name: voice

hooks.command: python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/hooks/codex-hook" deny '["Bash(kubectl apply*)", "Bash(kubectl delete*)", "Bash(terraform apply*)", "Bash(terraform destroy*)", "Bash(tofu apply*)", "Bash(tofu destroy*)", "Bash(pulumi up*)", "Bash(pulumi destroy*)", "Bash(gcloud * deploy*)", "Bash(gcloud run deploy*)", "Bash(aws * deploy*)", "Bash(helm install*)", "Bash(helm upgrade*)", "Bash(ssh *prod*)"]'

python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/hooks/codex-hook" deny '["Bash(git push --force*)", "Bash(git push -f*)", "Bash(git push --force-with-lease*)", "Bash(git push * --force*)", "Bash(git push * -f*)", "Bash(git push * --force-with-lease*)", "Bash(git push origin +*)", "Bash(git push * +*)"]'
